title: Fix Add Prompt persistence for prompts and categories

requirements.summary: Make '+ Add Prompt' Save await backend persistence and update in-memory state without closing on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new prompt (Title + Content + at least one Category) and clicking Save results in the prompt appearing in the currently active view/filter state as soon as Save completes.
After a full page refresh and re-authentication, the newly created prompt is still present (loaded from the backend).
If the backend call fails, the dialog remains open and an error toast is shown; the prompt is not silently lost.

file_operations.description: Change the Save handler to support an async onSave (Promise-based), show a saving/disabled state, and only close the shadcn-ui Dialog after onSave resolves successfully; keep dialog open on error. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the prompt save flow to return/await a Promise from the editor, avoid unconditional refresh that can mask save failures, and ensure the saved prompt remains visible under the current filters without forced navigation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden savePrompt to update Zustand prompt state deterministically (no stale-closure loss), propagate errors so the caller can keep the editor open, and ensure backend-synced prompts are merged without dropping newly created items. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Persist new categories created/selected during '+ Add Prompt' and reflect them in the CategoryFilterBar immediately and after refresh, without duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: When saving a prompt that includes a brand-new category name, that category appears in the CategoryFilterBar list (under the Favorites button) without requiring a manual refresh action.
After a full page refresh and re-authentication, the new category is still present in the CategoryFilterBar list (loaded from backend).
Saving a prompt with only existing categories does not create duplicate categories in the UI list or backend.

file_operations.description: Ensure saving a prompt also persists any missing categories to the backend (before or alongside prompt save), then updates the category store so CategoryFilterBar reflects the new category immediately; avoid re-creating categories that already exist. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Prevent duplicate category entries by enforcing trimmed + case-insensitive uniqueness for add/rename operations, so new categories don't appear multiple times in the filter bar. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

When creating a category, avoid adding duplicates to selectedCategories (including case/whitespace variants) and ensure the newly created category is selected exactly once for the prompt being edited. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align category mapping with the UI’s uniqueness rules (e.g., stable ID generation for equivalent names) to reduce duplicate persistence and improve consistency across refreshes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix category selection behavior so clicking a category reliably filters results and remains compatible with the current list/grid/table view behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: After saving a prompt into a category, clicking that category filters the prompt list to show the prompt(s) in that category.
In list/grid/table view modes, selecting a prompt in the filtered results opens the existing prompt preview behavior for that view (no broken/empty preview).
The app stays on the current view after Save (no forced navigation).

file_operations.description: Adjust filter state interactions so selecting a category disables Favorites-only mode (instead of intersecting filters unexpectedly), and preserve the active view mode after Save while keeping filtered results stable. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure category click interactions remain deterministic (toggle on/off) and integrate cleanly with the app’s filter state (category vs favorites) so filtering works immediately after saving new categories. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
